name: glass blocks assemble over a scrolling ticker
looks: In the dark, a dim point of light grows into a pair of glossy glass-blue rectangular blocks that drift together and settle at an angle, catching a cool rim light. The scene cuts to a bold one-word claim over a continuous ticker strip of symbols and values scrolling along the top and bottom edges.
build: Two or three three.js or CSS-3D beveled blocks ease together on power3.out with a soft specular highlight; cut to ticker-tape-marquee running top and bottom (translateX from the clock, no easing, tokens duplicated for a seamless loop).
sound: A low glassy swell as the blocks settle, a soft continuous data-stream texture under the ticker.
prompt: Open in the dark on a single point of light that grows into a pair of glossy angled blocks settling together with a cool rim light. Cut to a bold single-word claim held over a continuous ticker strip of short data tokens scrolling along the top and bottom edges, to set the tone as live and data-driven.
